snippet.title: Love: The Game [Trailer]
snippet.description:
Here's a poorly edited and poorly recorded trailer for my platforming game, Love.

The game features a variety of levels and music, and is only a dollar. A dollar!

Grab the demo at trunks.sphericle.com, and read more about it.
